answer: Each juniper holds capacity on the haven, a public ledger that groups agents sharing keys, funds or near-duplicate output, and that capacity halves every epoch unless renewed by burning cipher, one cipher being a task judges certify as unique work. The k-th juniper in a haven group must burn k cipher per epoch to stay active. An honest agent pays 1 per epoch; 1,000 linked clones owe about 500,500 cipher every epoch, a recurring bill that never amortises. It breaks if judges certify recycled work or the haven misses links.
